annotations.title: Show results with what you found

description: Show your user a search's results in one view with what you found on the web for each (a rating and where it comes from, the review count, a link, a one-line note). Optional, after find_local_businesses. Your additions are labeled as yours, never as Truvon's, and never change rank.

found.description: What you found, one entry per result you have something for

note.description: One line your user should know, in your words (160 characters)

rating_scale.description: Its scale, if not out of 5

rating_source.description: Where the rating comes from, e.g. "Google" or "Yelp" (required with a rating)

review_count.description: How many reviews it rests on

source_url.description: An https link to where you saw it

model.description: Optional: the model you run on (for example claude-sonnet-5-5), kept with the provenance of this call. Leave it out if you do not know.

name: show_results

follow_ups_due.description: Earlier outcomes due a follow-up with your user

measured_from.description: The point distances are measured from, and how it was found

next_cursor.description: The cursor for the next page (more_results); none on the last page

possible.description: Businesses that may fit, as the text lists them under Possible

truvon_id.description: Its Truvon ID (biz_…), the business argument of get_business_record and report_outcome

query.description: The need as read: what it matched on and the kind of business it calls for

results.description: The businesses that fit, best first, as the text lists them

truvon_id.description: Its Truvon ID (biz_…), the business argument of get_business_record and report_outcome

search_id.description: This search (srch_…), for report_outcome, show_results and refines

showing.description: What the results are, in one line

title: Show results with what you found
